prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1019
Claimant:
Catherine Cunningham
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
September 27, 2023
The insured reported a left-turn collision at an intersection, with the other vehicle striking the driver's side as the
insured was turning across oncoming traffic. The claimant's attorney has notified us of representation and asked that
all contact go through their office.
October 31, 2023
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the impact. The driver is named on
the policy, and the coverage records show no gap in coverage around the loss.
November 18, 2023
Spoke with the other driver, who gave the same description of the collision as the insured did. Photos from the scene
line up with that account and show the damage pattern we would expect from the impact.
November 20, 2023
Two independent witnesses gave statements confirming the left turn and the point of impact. Neither had any
connection to either party.
November 26, 2023
Inspected the vehicle and found damage largely consistent with the described impact. No earlier body damage or
prior repairs were visible, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
January 6, 2024
Claimant reports a back strain from the collision. The injury fits the kind and force of a side impact of this type, and the
claimant's account of symptoms has stayed the same in every contact so far.
January 9, 2024
Medical records show the claimant had a small strain in the same area several years ago, which resolved completely
with care. The prior episode has no bearing on the current complaint as documented.
January 25, 2024
Treatment followed a usual course for this kind of strain, with physical therapy and scheduled follow-up visits. Care
has tapered as the claimant's condition has improved.
February 6, 2024
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed the same account of the collision and the treatment timeline.
Requested updated treatment notes to close out the medical file.
March 22, 2024
Reviewed all materials gathered to date. The loss appears to match the reported facts, and the file is ready for the
next settlement review.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
